telnetCommands.label: تثبيت Picons SRP Full 220x132 — نسخة 2026-10-25
telnetCommands.command: URL="https://github.com/picons/picons/releases/download/2026-10-25--00-12-17/srp-full.220x132-190x102.light.on.transparent_2026-10-25--00-12-17.hardlink.tar.xz"; [ -d /media/hdd ] && BASE=/media/hdd || { [ -d /media/usb ] && BASE=/media/usb || { [ -d /media/mmc ] && BASE=/media/mmc || BASE=/usr/share/enigma2; }; }; mkdir -p $BASE/picon && cd /tmp && wget -O picons.tar.xz "$URL" && tar -xJf picons.tar.xz -C $BASE/picon --strip-components=1 && rm -rf /usr/share/enigma2/picon && ln -sfn $BASE/picon /usr/share/enigma2/picon && rm -f picons.tar.xz && sync && killall -9 enigma2
